one_liner: ELT for small data teams: pipelines as Python, 60+ connectors, runs in your VPC, flat $99/month — no per-row pricing.
description: pipewright moves data from SaaS tools and databases into your warehouse with pipelines defined as plain Python — versioned, testable, reviewable. It ships 60+ maintained connectors, deploys inside your own VPC so credentials and data never transit a vendor cloud, and charges a flat monthly price instead of Fivetran-style monthly-active-rows pricing that punishes growth.
target_user: Data engineers and analytics engineers at companies without a platform team

icp.who: The one-or-two-person data team at a 50-500 person company running a warehouse on Snowflake, BigQuery, or Postgres
icp.pain: Fivetran's MAR pricing explodes unpredictably as usage grows, while self-hosted Airbyte becomes a part-time job of babysitting broken syncs
icp.buying_trigger: A shocking Fivetran invoice, or the third weekend spent repairing a self-hosted Airbyte deployment

differentiators: Flat $99/month regardless of row volume — no monthly-active-rows meter
Pipelines are plain Python in your repo: diffable, testable, code-reviewed
Runs inside your VPC, so data and credentials never leave your infrastructure
proof_points: Syncs 40 million rows nightly for a fintech customer on the flat plan
Median connector setup time of 12 minutes, measured across onboarding cohort

voice.sample_phrase: Your bill shouldn't grow faster than your data team.

signals: Connector catalog published with source links

gaps: Smaller connector catalog than Airbyte's long tail

confidence.notes: Pricing model and VPC deployment are clearly documented. Scale claims trace to one named-industry customer.
